summary: List available RFI Priority filter options
description: Returns a list of available Priority options for RFIs

key.description: Integer value of the priority level (0=Low, 1=Medium, 2=High, 3=Urgent). Pass as `filters[priority][]=<key>` on the RFI list endpoint.

value.description: Human-readable display name of the priority level, e.g. `Medium`.
